question: Should this PR continue as a first-party Control UI MathJax implementation, and if so what dependency provenance and default delimiter behavior are acceptable before merge?
rationale: The requested feature is useful, but accepting global math parsing and same-origin third-party script execution is a product and security-boundary choice that automation should not make by default.

options.title: Track dependency and narrow parsing
options.body: Require a reviewed package/build or approved vendoring path, remove `$...$` as a default inline delimiter, and ask for real Control UI proof before merge.

options.title: Accept owner-approved vendoring
options.body: Allow the self-hosted MathJax asset only if maintainers explicitly document source, license, version, update, and review provenance and accept the delimiter behavior.

options.title: Defer this branch
options.body: Keep the canonical feature issue open and close or pause this PR if maintainers prefer a different KaTeX/MathJax design.

recommendation.title: Track dependency and narrow parsing
recommendation.body: Require a reviewed package/build or approved vendoring path, remove `$...$` as a default inline delimiter, and ask for real Control UI proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice spans Control UI product behavior and Gateway/CSP security boundaries, where steipete has adjacent history.
